description.text:
Chemical Risk Expo is a dedicated industrial risk platform bringing together safety leaders, EHS/PSM professionals, emergency response and mutual aid networks, ports and terminals, environmental remediation specialists, and public-sector stakeholders.

The focus is on reducing risk, preventing escalation, and accelerating recovery when incidents impact chemical and petrochemical infrastructure.

Part of the Natural Disasters Expo Series, the event provides a focused environment to explore the challenges associated with chemical incidents and the strategies used to mitigate and manage them. Attendees will also gain access to a wider programme featuring 30+ keynote speakers, 6 roundtable discussions, extensive seminar content, and more than 300 exhibitors across the series.

The event explores resilience, risk management, and operational continuity for chemical plants, refineries, terminals, tank farms, pipelines, and hazmat logistics operating in regions exposed to extreme weather and industrial incidents.

Chemical Risk Expo- 14-15 October 2026
George R. Brown Convention Center, Houston, TX

text.text:
Chemical Risk Expo brings together facility leaders, hazmat teams, PPE specialists, emergency responders, regulators, and resilience professionals to explore the future of industrial safety and chemical risk management.

The event will examine data-driven approaches to rapid detection, robust containment, coordinated emergency response, and infrastructure resilience across high-risk environments.

14-15 October 2026 | George R. Brown Convention Center
